Speedy Quark VPN is the world’s fastest and most secure free VPN proxy app. Protect yourself from cyber threats with a simple tap of the screen.

We have built a global VPN proxy network included America, Europe and Asia, and expand to more country soon. You can click the flag and change proxy server as any times as you want.
